title: Unit arrow circle
description: A hairline circle (34px in cards, 44px for carousel controls) holding a thin arrow pointing up-right, left or right. Its outline darkens on hover, or when the card around it (a `group/card`) is hovered; disabled circles fade to half.
notes: decorative span by default; a link with href, a button with onClick
name: unit-arrow-circle

props.name: direction
props.description: which way the arrow points: up-right (open), left or right (carousel)

props.name: href
props.description: a link when set; otherwise a decorative circle (or a button when onClick is given)

props.name: label
props.description: screen-reader label (required for links and buttons)

props.name: disabled
props.description: greys it out (a carousel at its end)
